quality_highlights.aspect: Model reference doc — experimental callout is prominent, recommended selection flow (6 numbered steps) is precise and actionable, and the related-docs footer links to cost-management and model-tables for context.

All three messages are context-aware and operationally clear: run-started explains what is being tested and the limit, run-success flags unexpected behavior with a ⚠️ and tells operators what to verify, run-failure explains why this is expected.

single_file_improvements.issue: Line 53: add-wizard command under 'Copilot Session Insights' heading points to copilot-agent-analysis.md (wrong file; should be copilot-session-insights.md). Line 59: add-wizard command for Copilot PR NLP Analysis is missing .md extension. Both errors would cause users to add wrong/non-existent workflows.

run-failure message is theatrical ('Alas! its quill fallen mid-verse. The poem remains unfinished...') and provides zero operational signal for operators investigating a failure. Matches recurring pattern across smoke-crush, smoke-codex, smoke-copilot-aoai-apikey, dev-hawk.
